activation.title: Before you start
activation.text: Ask about your family’s money, simulate a decision and get the next steps for your goals, trips and retirement.
activation.uses: Your question and, when it needs them, your transactions, income, emergency fund, debts, investments, goals, trips and calendar. Descriptions are sent exactly as they appear on your statement. Overnight, it uses the same data to prepare tips on each screen, tidy up your transaction categories and write the "What changed" paragraph in your reports.

spaces.title: Each family in its own space
spaces.text: Data is kept separate for each family right in the database, and this separation is covered by automated tests.

bank.title: No bank password
bank.text: You enter your transactions in OrganizeUp itself. We don’t ask for your bank password or access to your account.

connection.title: Protected connection
connection.text: Access happens over a secure connection (HTTPS), and your OrganizeUp password is never stored in plain text: it’s protected by a hash.

control.title: You’re in control
control.text: OrganizeUp organizes and explains. It doesn’t move money and doesn’t suggest buying or selling investments.

bank.q: Do I need to connect my bank account?
bank.a: No. You record what comes in and goes out in OrganizeUp itself, without giving your bank password or access.

who.a: Inside the system, only the people in your family’s space see this data. Each family is kept separate from the others.

invest.a: No. It helps you organize and understand your plan. Investment decisions remain yours.

mobile.q: Does it work on my phone?
mobile.a: Yes. The system was designed for the phone screen first and works right in the browser, with nothing to install.

ready.a: Not yet. OrganizeUp is being built in stages. On this page you can see what already works and what’s in progress.

closing.title: The next chapter starts with a conversation at home.

footer.text: OrganizeUp is a financial organization tool. It isn’t a bank or a brokerage, doesn’t move money and doesn’t make investment recommendations. Illustrative stock photos; the people shown are not customers.

how.title: How to connect
how.text: Pluggy is an Open Finance company. Its personal plan is free and accepts up to 5 connections of accounts in your own name.

steps.account: Create your account at meu.pluggy.ai and connect your banks there, under "Conectar Minha Conta". The authorization happens in the bank's own app. Check that the account shows up with a balance.
steps.dashboard: Create an account at dashboard.pluggy.ai, preferably with the same email. The 15-day trial notice is for companies and can be ignored for personal use.
steps.application: On the dashboard, open the Aplicações menu and click Novo. Give it any name, such as "My finances". One application is enough for all banks.
steps.secret: When you create it, Pluggy shows the Client Secret only once: copy it right away. The Client ID is always visible inside the application, under Credenciais. Lost the Client Secret? In the same place, click "Gerar novo secret"; the old one stops working.
steps.enable: Enable the connector: in the Dados Financeiros menu, open Customização and the Conectores tab. Under Personal, click "Conectores Diretos", turn MeuPluggy on and click Salvar. Without this, the list in the next step only shows Sandbox.
steps.connector: Go back to Aplicações and click the ▶ (Demo) icon on your application's row. Do not use the "Iniciar Demo" button at the top of the page: it belongs to another application, Pluggy Demo App, and a connection made through it does not work with your keys. Click "Conectar Conta", then Continuar, and choose MeuPluggy in the list. Repeat for each bank.
steps.items: The connection shows up under "Itens Conectados". Click it and use the copy button next to the identifier, at the top: that is the Item ID.
steps.paste: Paste the Client ID, the Client Secret and the Item IDs in the form below. The keys are encrypted and only you can use them.

auto.textOn: Whatever lands in the linked accounts and cards comes in by itself when you open the system, at most every 6 hours. What is already in is skipped, planned bills are settled, and each batch shows up in Import statement, with Undo. Investments still go through the review.
auto.textOff: Nothing comes in by itself. Use "Bring from the bank" in Import statement to review and save.
